gloss: can; may; able to; to approve; to permit; to suit; certainly; very
skipReason: Trivially known modal/function item for an HSK1-5 recognition-complete reader.

gloss: will; shall; to use; to take; just a short while ago
skipReason: Formal future/coverb use is function-word-like; better reinforced in reading than as a standalone vocab card.

gloss: general; to command; to lead; chess general

cards.front: In 将军, which reading of 将 do you retrieve, and what role does it name?
cards.back: jiàng; it names a general/commander. Do not read it as 将 jiāng, the formal future marker.
cards.retrievalTarget: 将 jiàng = general/commander; distinguish from 将 jiāng.

gloss: to do; to make; to go in for; to set up; to get hold of; to take care of

cards.front: Colloquial broad verb: 这件事我来 ___。
cards.back: 搞。这个 word is broad and casual: handle/do/get it done.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 搞 for colloquial 'handle/do/get done' when the action is broad.
cards.reason: Cues register and use without turning into a gloss quiz.

gloss: only; sole

cards.front: No second choice: 这是我 ___ 的办法。
cards.back: 唯一：这是我唯一的办法。Pattern: 唯一的 + noun.
cards.retrievalTarget: Produce 唯一的 + noun for a sole option/person/thing.

gloss: like this; so; such

cards.front: Written style, pointing back to the degree just described: 事情 ___ 难。
cards.back: 如此：事情如此难。It means “this/so” in a more written register than 这么.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 如此 to refer back to a previously described degree or manner in written style.
cards.reason: Contrasts register against easier 这么.

gloss: to be certain; positive; definitely; to affirm; affirmative answer

cards.front: 老师说“我 ___ 你的努力.” Here the word is not the adverb “definitely.” What action is it?
cards.back: 肯定 = affirm / give recognition to: 肯定你的努力。
cards.retrievalTarget: Recognize 肯定 as 'affirm/give recognition to', not only 'definitely'.
cards.reason: Targets a common overlooked non-adverb use.

gloss: his; her; its; their; that; such; it refers to something preceding it
skipReason: Formal pronoun/determiner; too function-word-like for this sample.

gloss: to kill; to murder; to attack; to weaken or reduce; extremely after a verb

cards.front: In 杀价, nobody dies. What non-literal meaning of 杀 is active?
cards.back: 杀价 = cut/bargain down the price; 杀 can mean reduce/weaken in compounds.
cards.retrievalTarget: Recall non-literal 杀 as 'cut/reduce/weaken' in compounds like 杀价.
cards.reason: Prevents over-literal reading of a frequent compound.

gloss: to control

cards.front: Keep feelings from getting out of hand: ___ 情绪。
cards.back: 控制情绪。Also common: 控制时间, 控制成本.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 控制 with things kept within limits, especially 情绪/时间/成本.
cards.reason: Teaches the useful object pattern rather than the English gloss.

gloss: sound; voice; tone; noise; reputation; classifier for sounds

cards.front: Measure word for one shout: 他叫了一 ___。
cards.back: 声：他叫了一声。声 counts discrete sounds or utterances.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 声 as the measure word for one discrete sound/utterance.

gloss: to organize; organization; tissue; weave

cards.front: 这个 ___ is a group; ___ 一个会 is a verb. Same word?
cards.back: 组织。这个组织 = organization; 组织一个会 = organize a meeting.
cards.retrievalTarget: Distinguish noun 组织 'organization' from verb 组织 'organize'.
cards.reason: Cues part-of-speech switching with simple scaffolding.

gloss: to have; to possess

cards.front: Formal possession, stronger than 有: 他 ___ 三套房。
cards.back: 拥有：他拥有三套房。Use it for assets, rights, resources, or qualities.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 拥有 for formal possession of assets/resources/rights, not casual 有.

gloss: to order; to command; an order; to cause; honorific title

cards.front: Formal “make people feel”: 这件事 ___ 人高兴。
cards.back: 令：这件事令人高兴。Pattern: 令 + 人 + reaction.
cards.retrievalTarget: Recall 令 + 人 + reaction as formal 'make people feel/react'.

gloss: deity; spirit; soul; unusual; lively

cards.front: Colloquial praise/surprise: 你太 ___ 了！Here it is not about religion.
cards.back: 神：你太神了 = you’re amazing / uncannily good.
cards.retrievalTarget: Recognize colloquial 神 as 'amazing/uncanny/mysteriously good'.

gloss: to arrive; most; to; until
skipReason: Bound/formal function morpheme; better learned through compounds such as 至少/甚至/至今.

gloss: one more time; again; once again

cards.front: More formal than 又: 我们明天 ___ 见。
cards.back: 再次：我们明天再次见。It is a written/formal “once again.”
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 再次 as a formal adverbial 'once again' before the verb.

gloss: to renounce; to abandon; to give up

cards.front: You decide not to keep a chance: ___ 这个机会。
cards.back: 放弃：放弃这个机会。Common objects include 机会, 计划, 权利.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 放弃 with chances, plans, rights, or pursuits you stop keeping/pursuing.

gloss: even if; even though
skipReason: Conjunction/function word; skipped for this content-word sample.

gloss: despite; although; even though; unhesitatingly; go ahead
second; arc second; instantly

cards.front: In 秒回, the time idea is not literally measured with a clock. What does 秒 add?
cards.back: 秒 = instantly / right away: 秒回 = reply instantly.
cards.retrievalTarget: Recognize 秒 as colloquial 'instantly' in compounds like 秒回/秒懂.
cards.reason: Targets the productive internet-style prefix use.

gloss: to accompany; to keep someone company; to assist

cards.front: Someone is afraid to go alone: 明天我 ___ 你去。
cards.back: 陪：明天我陪你去。陪 means being with someone through the action.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 陪 for accompanying/keeping someone company during an activity.
cards.reason: Simple production cue for the core social use.

gloss: unexpectedly; to one's surprise; go so far as to

cards.front: You expected him to fail: 他 ___ 考第一。Which adverb marks surprise?
cards.back: 居然：他居然考第一。It marks “against expectation.”
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 居然 when the event violates the speaker's expectation.

gloss: client; customer

cards.front: Company word, not shop guest: ___ 服务, ___ 关系。
cards.back: 客户：客户服务, 客户关系。Use 客户 for business clients/customers.
cards.retrievalTarget: Recall 客户 for business client/customer in 客户服务/客户关系.
cards.reason: Anchors the word to business collocations.

gloss: to analyze; analysis

cards.front: Before deciding, a report will ___ 原因。
cards.back: 分析原因。Also: 分析问题, 分析数据.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 分析 with causes, problems, or data as objects.

gloss: to enjoy; to live it up; pleasure

cards.front: Not just like it; savor it slowly: 好好 ___ 这个周末。
cards.back: 享受：好好享受这个周末。It focuses on experiencing the pleasure/benefit.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 享受 for savoring/enjoying an experience or benefit.
cards.reason: Distinguishes it from simple 喜欢.

gloss: crucial point; crux; key; crucial; pivotal

cards.front: Sentence frame for “the key is…”: ___ 是他来不来。
cards.back: 关键：关键是他来不来。关键 can be noun-like before 是.
cards.retrievalTarget: Produce 关键是... for 'the key/crux is...'.

gloss: champion

cards.front: After taking first place, the usual phrase is 拿到 ___。
cards.back: 冠军：拿到冠军。Also 获得冠军 in more formal style.
cards.retrievalTarget: Recall 冠军 with 拿到/获得 as the title won after first place.

gloss: to grab; to rob; to snatch; to rush; to scramble

cards.front: In 抢票, people hurry before others get it. What action does 抢 add?
cards.back: 抢 = grab/scramble for something competitively: 抢票, 抢座.
cards.retrievalTarget: Recognize 抢 as competitive grabbing/scrambling, not only robbing.

gloss: foolish

cards.front: Naive/foolish behavior: 别这么 ___。Choose the word, not 呆。
cards.back: 傻：别这么傻。傻 targets foolish judgment; 呆 is more blank/frozen or stay.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 傻 for foolish/naive behavior; distinguish from 呆.
cards.reason: Pairs near-synonyms without adding hard scaffolding.

gloss: to wait; to treat; to deal with; going to do something

cards.front: In 对待人, 待 is not “stay.” What does it mean here?
cards.back: 待 dài = treat/deal with: 对待人, 待人好. Spoken 'stay' is often dāi/待着.
cards.retrievalTarget: Recognize 待 dài as 'treat/deal with' in 对待/待人, separate from dāi 'stay'.

gloss: to reinstate; to resume; to restore; to recover; to regain; to rehabilitate

cards.front: After being sick, return to normal: ___ 健康。
cards.back: 恢复健康。Also 恢复工作, 恢复正常.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 恢复 for returning health/work/state to normal.

gloss: stick; club; smart; capable; strong; wonderful; relay-race classifier

cards.front: Praise: 你今天做得很 ___。Not the object “stick.”
cards.back: 棒：你今天做得很棒 = you did great.
cards.retrievalTarget: Recognize 棒 as colloquial praise meaning 'great/excellent'.

gloss: consciousness; awareness; to be aware; to realize

cards.front: Pattern for “realize a fact”: ___ 到这件事很难。
cards.back: 意识到：意识到这件事很难。Use 意识到 + fact/problem.
cards.retrievalTarget: Produce 意识到 + fact/problem for 'realize/become aware'.

gloss: in case; if; once something happens; when; in a short time; in one day
skipReason: Conjunction-like trigger word; skipped for this content/collocation sample.

gloss: to implement; to carry out; to execute; to run

cards.front: Plans and orders are not just 做; they are ___: ___ 计划。
cards.back: 执行计划。Also 执行命令, 执行任务.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 执行 for carrying out plans, orders, tasks, or programs.

gloss: to share something good with others

cards.front: At a meeting: 我想跟大家 ___ 一个好办法。
cards.back: 分享：我想跟大家分享一个好办法。It implies letting others benefit from it.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 分享 for sharing useful ideas, experience, resources, or good things with others.
cards.reason: Simple production card with social-benefit nuance.

gloss: woman; the female sex

cards.front: Formal report category, not casual 女人: ___ 学生很多。
cards.back: 女性：女性学生很多。Use 女性 in formal/statistical/social-category contexts.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 女性 as the formal category term for women/female people.
cards.notes: Pinyin normalized from source nu:3 xìng to nǚ xìng after CEDICT check.
cards.reason: Targets register distinction and corrects source pinyin format.

gloss: classifier for small spheres, pearls, corn grains, teeth, hearts, satellites etc.
skipReason: Measure word; skipped as lower standalone value for this sample.

gloss: to dislike; to loathe; disagreeable; troublesome; annoying

cards.front: Verb or adjective? 我 ___ 他; 这个人很 ___。Retrieve the one word that fits both.
cards.back: 讨厌。我讨厌他 = I dislike him; 这个人很讨厌 = this person is annoying.
cards.retrievalTarget: Distinguish verbal 讨厌 'dislike' from adjectival 讨厌 'annoying'.
cards.reason: Tests two common syntactic roles at once.

gloss: person; personage; figure; character in a play or novel; figure painting

cards.front: For a novel character or a famous historical figure, use the same word: 小说___ / 历史___。
cards.back: 人物：小说人物, 历史人物。人物 suggests a figure in a story, history, or public life.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 人物 for literary characters and notable historical/public figures.
cards.reason: Targets the semantic range beyond generic 人.

gloss: gun; rifle; spear

cards.front: Measure word: police found 一把 ___。
cards.back: 枪：一把枪。Use 把 as the common measure word.
cards.retrievalTarget: Recall 枪 with measure word 把: 一把枪.

gloss: to refuse; to decline; to reject

cards.front: Formal “say no” to an invite: ___ 邀请。
cards.back: 拒绝邀请。Also 拒绝要求, 拒绝帮助.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 拒绝 with invitations, requests, offers, or help.
cards.reason: Anchors the verb to natural objects.

gloss: insane; mad; wild

cards.front: Non-clinical speech: 别 ___ 了！What word marks wild/crazy behavior?
cards.back: 疯：别疯了！Often means wild/out of control, not a medical diagnosis.
cards.retrievalTarget: Recognize 疯 as colloquial 'crazy/wild/out of control'.

gloss: type; form; pattern; style
skipReason: Mostly bound suffix/morpheme in compounds like 方式/形式/中式; weak standalone target.

gloss: foolish; stupid; expressionless; blank; to stay

cards.front: Blank/frozen from shock: 他吓得 ___ 住了。Choose the word, not 傻。
cards.back: 呆：他吓得呆住了。呆 can mean blank/frozen/stupefied.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 呆 for blank/frozen/stupefied states; distinguish from 傻.
cards.reason: Near-synonym repair with simple sentence frame.

gloss: ghost; devil; suffix for person with a vice/addiction; sly; crafty

cards.front: 酒鬼 is not literally a ghost. What does 鬼 mark in words like this?
cards.back: 鬼 = person strongly associated with a habit/vice/trait: 酒鬼, 烟鬼, 小气鬼.
cards.retrievalTarget: Recognize 鬼 as a suffix for a person marked by a habit, vice, or trait.

gloss: a register; block of printing; edition; version; page

cards.front: Edition/version word: 中文___, 新___。
cards.back: 版：中文版, 新版。Also 电子版, 最新版.
cards.retrievalTarget: Recall 版 as 'edition/version' in compounds like 中文版/新版/电子版.

gloss: agreement; pact; protocol

cards.front: Both 签 ___ and 网络 ___ use the same word for agreed rules/terms. What word?
cards.back: 协议：签协议 = sign an agreement; 网络协议 = network protocol.
cards.retrievalTarget: Recall 协议 as agreed terms/rules, covering agreements and technical protocols.
cards.reason: Connects legal and technical senses by shared invariant.

gloss: to compete; competition

cards.front: Market/job rivalry: 激烈的 ___。
cards.back: 竞争：激烈的竞争。As a verb: 两家公司竞争.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 竞争 as noun/verb for rivalry in markets, jobs, or groups.

gloss: to estimate; to reckon; colloquially to suppose

cards.front: 我 ___ 他不会来。This is a guess/reckoning, not math. What word?
cards.back: 估计：我估计他不会来 = I reckon/suppose he won't come.
cards.retrievalTarget: Recognize colloquial 估计 as 'reckon/suppose/probably'.
cards.reason: Targets the frequent spoken stance marker.

gloss: to signify; to mean; to imply

cards.front: Event → implication: 这 ___ 我们要重做。
cards.back: 意味着：这意味着我们要重做。It links a fact/event to what follows from it.
cards.retrievalTarget: Produce 意味着 to link an event/sign to its implication.

gloss: club; organization or premises; loanword

cards.front: Sports/hobby club loanword: 足球___。
cards.back: 俱乐部：足球俱乐部。Also 健身俱乐部, 会员俱乐部.
cards.retrievalTarget: Recall 俱乐部 for sports, hobby, or member clubs.
cards.reason: Anchors a long loanword to a familiar compound.

gloss: inside; among; in the midst of; during
skipReason: Formal locative/function phrase; better acquired through sentence reading.

gloss: to construct; building

cards.front: 这座 ___ is a building; ___ 一座桥 is a verb. Same word?
cards.back: 建筑。这座建筑 = this building; 建筑一座桥 = construct a bridge.
cards.retrievalTarget: Distinguish 建筑 as noun 'building' from verb 'construct'.

gloss: to lose; to put aside; to throw

cards.front: 手机不见了, not deliberately thrown away: 手机 ___ 了。
cards.back: 丢：手机丢了 = the phone got lost. 扔 is deliberate throwing/throwing away.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 丢 for unintentionally losing something; distinguish from 扔.

gloss: crazy; frenzied; wild

cards.front: Very intense/out of control action: ___ 买东西。
cards.back: 疯狂：疯狂买东西。Also 疯狂工作, 疯狂增长.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 疯狂 before verbs/nouns for intense, frenzied, out-of-control action.

gloss: width; roll; classifier for textiles or pictures
skipReason: Measure word for pictures/textiles; skipped as lower standalone value.

gloss: to dance; to wield; to brandish

cards.front: Dance/performance morpheme: 跳___, ___台。
cards.back: 舞：跳舞, 舞台。Also 舞会.
cards.retrievalTarget: Recall 舞 in common dance/performance compounds: 跳舞, 舞台, 舞会.

gloss: to invite; invitation

cards.front: Polite/formal ask to come: ___ 他来。
cards.back: 邀请：邀请他来。As a noun: 收到邀请.
cards.retrievalTarget: Use 邀请 as verb 'invite' and noun 'invitation' in event/social contexts.
cards.reason: Tests simple production and noun/verb flexibility.
